body:

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；读「多语言」和「数据建模」技能的 AI 助手现在知道，流程里每一步的名称、以及记录页上自定义的关联列表标签页标题，各自该写在哪个翻译位置。
- 为什么做：这两个翻译位置已经随平台发布，技能文字却没跟上，是「流程步骤名可翻译」和「关联列表标题可翻译」两项改动各自欠下的技能说明，这里一次补齐。
- 出错会怎样：只是技能里的几句说明和一条测评用例，不影响任何运行行为；写错的话 AI 助手会把翻译写到不生效的位置，可以直接撤回这一个合并。
- 要你做什么：批准合并。只改技能文字和一道评测题；因为一个 PR 同时关两张卡，工具无法判断走哪张卡的低风险通道，所以按需要人工批准处理。契约审核 PASS：记录 7141681211，Head-sha `7523971c565c850e5183385030f0007e4ff08fd0`。

## What changes

One commit per card, then one merge of `main` and one fix commit after the contract review.

**`76538fe36f`, the flow step-name key (#36401, the follow-up owed by the flows `nodes` group).** `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, the paragraph on keys that sit deeper than their group's `label`, now names a fourth key:

> any other step's name at `flows.{flow}.nodes.{node_id}.label` (a screen is named by its heading, `flows.{flow}.screens.{node_id}.title`, and takes a `nodes` key only beside a `title` of its own; `os i18n check` asks for a flow's top-level steps, and for one of `FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` — `script`, `http`, `connector_action`, `assignment`, `boundary_event`, the four `*_record` types — only where a decision's branch leads to it)

"Three keys" and "all three keys included" become four. This is what the readers do: the walk in `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts` asks `nodes.NODE_ID.label` for each top-level node, skips an `approval` (keyed `approvals.NODE_ID.label`) and a screen whose label `screens.NODE_ID.title` already covers, skips `isFlowTechnicalNodeType` nodes, and adds back a technical step a drawn decision's branch names (`decisionBranchTechnicalTargets`); `os i18n extract` reads the same walk. The nine types are the literal list of `FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` in `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-altitude.ts`, whose source file does not ship in the package, so the skill lists them.

**`cd690662c7`, the related-list title key (#36575, the follow-up owed by the related-list title translation).**

- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, the object translation group table, gains the `_relatedLists.{list}` row beside `_tabs`: the `label` of an object-form `relatedLists` entry on the parent object, by the entry's literal `list` (`event.related_to` is one key); an entry with no `label` has no key and keeps the child field's `relatedListTitle`, else the child's plural label; "Spelled `relatedLists`, the group is refused, naming this one" (the alias table of `ObjectTranslationDataSchema` maps the unprefixed spelling to `_relatedLists` as a refusal, never an accepted second spelling).
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, the `relatedLists` entry: "its `label` translates at `objects.{parent}._relatedLists.{list}.label` (none: nothing to translate)".
- `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`: one case (id 16) covering both keys.

Precedence is stated as the contract has it (`RelatedListEntryObjectSchema.label` in `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`: the entry `label`, then the child FK's `relatedListTitle`, then the child's plural label).

**`40f4e27ee0`, merge of `origin/main` `159113f4fe`** (plain merge, no conflict; brings #37044's edit to the same file).

**`7523971c56`, the contract review's S1 and N1** (record 7141134189), `relationships.md` only:
- S1: the `'primary'` bullet ends "its tab stays unless `relatedLists` omits it" again (the first round had cut the qualifier, leaving a sentence that was false for a declared list that omits the child).
- N1: "override the derived title / columns (columns: the child's `highlightFields`); an entry's `label` / `columns` win."

**Paid in the same files; no ceiling of the skills token ratchet moves.** Restatement cut from `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`: three sentences repeating the heading above them; the "Use both gates" paragraph keeps its one new fact; the `relatedListTitle` cell says "likewise"; "Requires `--out`" loses its restating clause; the per-namespace row loses "assembled by your own imports" (said above the table for every layout); "Both shipped adapters" loses the parenthetical the Service Contract section spells in full; the `translation` item section loses its heading restated as a sentence; the Register step folds a repeat of the authoring section.

Cut from `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, inside the related-list section: "absent, nothing changes" (the section opens by saying every child relationship shows by default, and objectstack-ui Record Page says it too); the section's opening sentence loses "You usually don't declare the related list on the parent's record detail page" (it restated "by default"); "a self-referential FK (a hierarchy)" loses the parenthetical. The "Catalog auto-fill" bullet and the Delete Behaviors section are untouched.

The two authored files are 27 bytes smaller together; the eval case is the tree's only growth.

## Tests

Text only: no package source, test or behaviour changes, so there is no ablation. The pins the text was written from were read, not edited: `packages/cli/test/i18n-flow-node-coverage.test.ts` and `packages/lint/src/i18n-related-lists-label-36528.test.ts`.

## Acceptance notes

- The body opens with the seat signature line; the closing lines follow it.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` were NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, prerequisite: a whole-workspace build); the diff touches no package and CI runs both.
- The flows `nodes` key is accepted by `os validate` at any depth and for a titled screen; the skill teaches what `os i18n check` asks for and the one screen rule an author can get wrong, not the full acceptance set.
- Contract review nit N2 (the nine-type list is a hand copy of `FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` with no gate tying them) is accepted as is.

## Verification

Read first, by risk: the "Four keys sit deeper" paragraph and the `_relatedLists.{list}` row of `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`; the three related-list bullets of `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`.
